Man Fatally Shot at London Memorial Service, Police Launch Manhunt

A 40-year-old man was fatally shot in front of approximately 50 people, including children, during a memorial service in west London. Police described the incident as a 'senseless act of violence' and have launched a manhunt for the perpetrator. The shooting occurred while attendees were gathered for the service.
